```python
import griffe
from griffe.dataclasses import Function

# Load the requests package using the module-level convenience entry point
requests_api = griffe.load("requests")

# Get all public top-level functions
public_functions = [
    name for name, member in requests_api.members.items()
    if not name.startswith("_") and isinstance(member, Function)
]

# Print the names
for name in sorted(public_functions):
    print(name)
```
